Letters, résumés, stories, scripts and plans

Text, code, documents and vector drawings use the language engine. Reading aloud uses the device. Realistic photos, videos, music, voice cloning and Brazilian Sign Language are not available yet: they require other models and infrastructure.
Memory personalizes responses using saved information. It does not train model weights or share data between people.
Allow saving and using my next conversations as memory

When enabled, each completed exchange saves up to 2,000 characters in the Teravs service database. Limit: 100 memories. Earlier conversations are not imported automatically. Disabling prevents further saving and use; deleting removes the records.
Something you want me to remember

With an account, authorized memories are stored in Supabase and accessible on other devices. Visible history stays on this device, separated by account. Signing out does not delete memories: use the delete button when needed.
